name: new parenthood
description: A deep sense of amazement, pride, and meaning from interacting with your young child.
alternateDefinitions: Parenthood in general is a wide range of experiences covered elsewhere. The experience of marvelling at your newborn is unique.
perceptions: That baby or toddler is my child.
results: Tiring, expensive, life changing, yes. But many find this experience worthwhile.

comparisons.description: 'Baby love' is more about your feelings towards the young one. 'New parenthood' is about the wonder, pride, and meaning you feel about being a parent.

commentaries.quote: The most precious jewels you'll ever have around your neck are the arms of your children.
Children are not things to be molded, but are people to be unfolded.
Making the decision to have a child is momentous. It is to decide forever to have your heart go walking around outside your body.
Parenting is the art of guiding a child to discover the world while rediscovering it through their innocent eyes, and in doing so, finding the magic in everyday moments.
A baby is God's opinion that the world should go on.
It's good that a love of our offspring is built in - that phase of their existence is much longer and more difficult than the brief reward of conception.
